items.title: Håkan Rydin interviewed by Monk Rowe, Glasgow, Scotland, July 27, 2016
items.q: Not so very much, yeah? Well of course I’ve heard it, that’s a great piano player.

ctx.x: Yes, those amazing moments. I mean that’s why it’s so nice to play music, isn’t it, because it’s another kind of communication. It’s very direct. [claps] I mean it’s like that. I mean we can talk and we can communicate pretty good I hope, but playing is another level, not necessarily higher, but another level of communication. Very direct, very honest in a way. I mean it’s there. It should be there.
Let me run a couple of names by you and see if they mean anything. Ramsey Lewis?
Not so very much, yeah? Well of course I’ve heard it, that’s a great piano player.
